name: The Ritz-Carlton, Toronto
positioning: Downtown Toronto Ritz-Carlton connected to the PATH walkway, with Italian dining and art-accented decor
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown base near the Rogers Centre, Scotiabank Arena and the subway
Families interested in the Ritz Kids program

facts.text: The hotel is directly connected to the PATH underground walkway and the St. Andrew subway station.
The hotel is close to the Rogers Centre, Scotiabank Arena and the centre of the Toronto International Film Festival.
Guest room finishes are inspired by the city, with patterns and lines reminiscent of the lakeshore and railway system.
The decor is accented by more than 400 pieces of Canadian art.
LANO is a Northern Italian cafe and wine bar.
EPOCH Bar + Kitchen Terrace is a modern take on the gastrobar.
Guest rooms have feather beds with Frette linens.
The hotel has a heated indoor saltwater pool.
The fitness centre has Peloton bikes.

highlights.text: The decor is accented by more than 400 pieces of Canadian art.
The hotel is directly connected to the PATH underground walkway and the St. Andrew subway station.
Guest room finishes are inspired by the city, with patterns and lines reminiscent of the lakeshore and railway system.
The Ritz Kids program introduces young guests to four pillars: water, land, environmental responsibility and culture.
Guests can book a tailored Niagara Falls and Niagara-on-the-Lake trip with a certified guide and private transport options.

considerations.text: The Ritz-Carlton Spa is temporarily closed for renovation.
Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
